groups.comment: The manifest path is accepted only after the store ID rejects empty/dot/separator forms and containWithin verifies lexical and real-root containment. A null result is rejected before reading; real filesystem tests cover traversal and pre-existing links. This is a validated store lookup, not an unconstrained path input.

The taint source is the owner's SAND_LOCAL_EXEC_ROOT/SAND_AGENT_PROJECT_DIR startup configuration. Local execution intentionally uses that configured root and confines request paths before the atomic writer. The mkdir operand is not an unvalidated remote path.

CODEX_HOME is an explicit owner-selected credentials directory. The reader opens a direct regular private file, checks that same descriptor, and reads through it. This path-injection trace originates in startup configuration; it does not bypass a confined remote path boundary.

DISPLAY is passed as an independent argv parameter to a fixed Bash script and used only through quoted $1. It is not interpolated into shell source. Real Bash tests with $(), backticks, quotes and whitespace verify literal argument transfer and no extra command execution.

Retain until correction and a fresh analysis: existing real-path checks prevent pre-existing link escape, but stat/path reads must use the same opened descriptor with bounded reads. No dismissal is authorized for these race findings.

These regression tests intentionally inspect and change real files in their private mkdtemp fixture to verify credential descriptor identity, safe marker publication, and WAL replacement rejection. The stat/read pairs are test assertions, not production authorization decisions.

The frontmatter destinations are null-prototype dictionaries at every nested level. Dynamic keys are intentional input data and cannot invoke Object.prototype setters. Production-parser tests verify __proto__/constructor remain own data and cannot inject inherited workflow name/trigger fields.
